newsitem.title: USA: Railtex May carloadings up 37 percent.
newsitem.headline: Railtex May carloadings up 37 percent.

text.p: RailTex Inc said Friday May 1997 carloadings rose 37 percent to 40,982 from 29,855 in May 1996.
The company said it had traffic gains in autos, chemicals, farm products, paper, metals and other products.
On a "same railroad" basis, carloadings rose 3 percent to 30,805 in May 1997 from 29,822 in May 1996.

It said year-to-date May 1997 carloadings rose 31 percent to 192,042 from 146,190 in the prior year period. "Same railroad" carloadings rose 2 percent to 147,174 from 145,034 in the prior year period, it said.
